title: Snake Eater Ladder Song
description: Adds Snake Eater's iconic ladder music!
body:
This datapack adds the iconic Snake Eater Ladder song!

Showcase: <iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/mLDmzgChCbU" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Remember that this needs the included rescource pack to work, so download both.

**HOW TO USE:**
Enable both the datapack and rescource pack.
Run your world.
Done!

The song will play if you are climbing any block.
This means any block with the climbable tag!

**CONFIG:**
There is only one option, and it is whether you want the musical version or the acappella version. It does default to the acapella, which is the original.

The command is;
**/function snake:toggle_song_type**

This datapack is multiplayer friendly, so dont worry about it not working!
